# QualityLayer

> QualityLayer puts the engineer back in the loop of a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, Grok, Antigravity). Every change goes through Discuss, Research, Plan, Outline, Implement, Verify and Review: you approve the Plan before any code exists, the agent builds test first, and an agent that did not write the code checks the result against every agreed outcome before you approve the pull request. Plans and evidence are Markdown files in your repository.

Even the best models don't build software the way an experienced engineer would, and the plan modes of coding agents are neither collaborative nor visual. QualityLayer brings human engineering judgment back into the loop: you decide on the plan, teammates can comment on it, and you review the evidence before anything is merged.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs): what QualityLayer is and the seven steps
- [Install](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/install): one command on macOS, Windows and Linux
- [First task](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/first-task): run a change from request to pull request
- [Plan step](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/steps/plan): the Plan you approve before code
- [Verify step](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/steps/verify): how each agreed outcome is checked with evidence
- [Review step](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/steps/review): approving the finished change
- [Supported agents](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/agents/native): Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more
- [Team plans](https://qualitylayer.dev/docs/team/plans): reviewing a Plan together
